headline: Cloth Trader Shot At In Amritsar After Refusing Extortion Demand, CCTV Captures Horror
content: A cloth trader was critically injured after unidentified assailants on Thursday opened fire on him outside his residence in Sunder Nagar in Amritsar, Punjab. The attack was captured on CCTV, and the incident is suspected to be linked to an extortion demand. The attack follows yet another shooting incident in Punjab, involving an anti-drug activist, who was killed by a chemist after he questioned him over the alleged sale of addictive drugs to an individual. Vishal, alias Gori, who ran a cloth trading business in Amritsar, was shot at by unidentified assailants near his residence. CCTV footage showed him arriving on a motorcycle with another person. As the two reached the area, two assailants approached them and opened fire before fleeing the scene. Soon after, Vishal fell on the ground, sustaining serious injuries. The attack is suspected to be linked to an extortion demand, which was reportedly rejected by the victim. At present, Vishal is undergoing treatment at the hospital. The incident has raised fresh concerns over public safety and law and order in Amritsar, with questions being raised about the authorities’ response to extortion-related violence. Anti-Drug Activist Killed By Chemist The incident comes close to the heels of a shooting incident in Punjab’s Mansa, where an anti-drug activist, Parvinder Singh Jhota, was killed by a medical store owner after he allegedly questioned him over the purported sale of addictive drugs to an individual. Jhota, who was recording the confrontation on his mobile phone, was shot by the chemist. He was immediately rushed to a hospital, where he succumbed to his injuries. The incident sparked a massive outrage against the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)-led Punjab Government. Protests also erupted in Mansa after locals stormed into the chemist shop and set it ablaze, with police personnel present at the site. Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, meanwhile, has vowed that strict action would be taken against those responsible for the activist’s killing. “If there are any conspirators in the Mansa case, they will also be investigated. Any potential involvement of the drug mafia or other such elements will also be investigated”, Mann said.
